capabilities: Export canvases as vector PDF with selectable, searchable text
Export canvases as standalone HTML files
Render nested canvases embedded up to five levels deep
Include connectors, arrows, labels, images, web cards, and embedded PDFs in exports
Configure default export path and nested-canvas depth in settings
extras: Requires Obsidian v1.4.0+ on desktop; uses Chrome DevTools Protocol to print via a local Chromium instance, communicating only over 127.0.0.1; documents edge cases like zoomed-out PDF card virtualization and Adobe Acrobat's 200-inch page limit.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a canvas into a high-quality document; screenshots produce pixelated, non-searchable images with lost connectors and labels.
summary: Exports Obsidian canvases to searchable vector PDF or standalone HTML files by rendering them through a local Chrome or Edge browser.
